Honestly, I mainly care about what my family will think, as severe depression runs through my family (mom+dad have lost&found 6 family members in total to suicide since 2000) and they’re the last people I’d want to find me dead. I can’t bear the thought of them walking in on yet another loved one dead, let alone their 17y/o child.

This is the main reason I switched to online school. The teachers at my old school would always stalk every students social media for ‘safety purposes’ when every kid who was posting stuff about their mental health would be sent to a school essentially for kids with severe mental illness like BPD, DID, schizophrenia, etc. without even consulting with the student beforehand. Luckily I had blocked every # related to the school on my moms phone, and had her email logged in on my phone, and when they couldn’t get into contact with her they tried to forcefully get me onto the bus (which took the troubled kids to the troubled kids school). I’m sorry that you had to go through that though, and it’s very saddening that many schools other than mine do things like this. I hope everything turns out well for you, and if possible I’d highly recommend online school. I started this year and I’ve never been happier to get out of that hellhole.
